newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk shares extend losses on political uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Turk shares extend losses on political uncertainty.

text.p: Istanbul shares extended earlier losses sharply at the start of the second session on Thursday as the ruling coalition's Islamist and conservative partners discussed the government's future, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 dived 2.59 percent to a day's low of 1,617 in the first hour of the afternoon session. It later recovered to 1,627 at 1154 GMT, down 32 points, or 1.99 percent from Wednesday.
Brokers said the market aimed to find fresh support after the index's 1,650 support was pierced down in morning sales amid mounting political uncertainty.
"Speculators are dominant in the market and they are testing the downside now," said Erden Gokay from Taksim securities.
